notes: This bounded contract joins the 2025 Query GALT/Query LITS service candidates with the private federation time-bounds calculator and a real C++ queued-TSO resignation case. It proves that a future queued timestamp can keep LITS defined after the source regulator resigns while GALT becomes undefined; it does not claim complete time coordination, transport, alternate advances, save/restore, JUnit, protected review, or conformance.
